headline: Lyceum Committee to review Fall 2026 Program plans and working group updates on Celebration program and State of World Health.
summary: The committee will welcome a new member, hear a chair report, get updates from the Celebration program and State of World Health working groups, and review the Fall 2026 Program including a site visit to Kyrouz Auditorium.

# GLOUCESTER LYCEUM
ENGAGING MINDS, INSPIRING CONVERSATIONS

## Gloucester Lyceum Committee
Thursday, October 15, 2026, 5:00- 6:30 pm
Gloucester City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue
1st Floor Council Conference Room

As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows,
this committee will continue to hold meetings remotely.
Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below.
Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86207455773
Dial in at 646-931 3860 US

## Agenda

1. Call to order
2. Approval of Minutes for September 10, 2026
3. Welcome new member: Kathleen Black Reynolds/Introductions (5 minutes)
4. Chair report  (misc.) (Julia—10 minutes)
5. "Celebration" program working group update (Martha, Annie, Stephen, Meredith—15 minutes)
6. State of World Health working group update (Leora, Stan, Martha—10 minutes)
7. Fall 2026 Program Update (Julia, Doug, Stan, Ann—40 minutes)
   Site visit:  Kyrouz Auditorium
8. Next Meeting: Thursday, November 12, 5 pm:  SFL Conference Room
9. Adjourn
